name: batzio
description: Batzio – agent-first Swiss accounting: web, API, Apple, Android and Windows apps

scripts.gen: pnpm --filter @batzio/tokens gen && pnpm --filter @batzio/i18n gen && pnpm --filter @batzio/local build
scripts.check:gen: pnpm --filter @batzio/tokens check && pnpm --filter @batzio/i18n check && pnpm --filter @batzio/local check
scripts.apple: cd apps/apple && xcodegen generate && open Batzio.xcodeproj
